welcome:
Welcome to the Flux CD CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated GitOps environment.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check that your cluster meets the prerequisites for Flux.
Prerequisites pass. Bootstrap Flux with your GitHub repository.
Good, Flux is installed. Verify that all Flux components are healthy.
Now create a GitRepository source pointing to your application repo.
steps.hint: Try: flux create source git webapp --url=https://github.com/acme-corp/webapp --branch=main --interval=1m

steps.instruction: Create a Kustomization to deploy the app from the source.
Verify the source was picked up and has a revision.
Check that the kustomization reconciled successfully.
Force an immediate reconciliation of the git source to pull latest changes.
steps.hint: Try: flux reconcile source git webapp

steps.instruction: Something is wrong in the cluster. Get an overview of all Flux resources.
The payments kustomization shows 'Not Ready'. Check recent Flux events for clues.
The events show a validation error. Check the Flux logs for more detail.
You need to fix the manifest in Git. Suspend the kustomization to stop retries while you fix it.
You've pushed the fix to Git. Resume the kustomization.
Force an immediate reconciliation of the source to pick up your fix.
steps.hint: Try: flux reconcile source git flux-system

steps.instruction: Now force the kustomization to reconcile with the updated source.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  flux check [--pre]                  — Check Flux prerequisites or installation
  flux bootstrap [github|gitlab]      — Install Flux and configure GitOps
  flux get [resource]                 — List Flux resources (all, sources git, sources helm, kustomizations, helmreleases)
  flux create source [git|helm]       — Create a source resource
  flux create kustomization           — Create a Kustomization resource
  flux create helmrelease             — Create a HelmRelease resource
  flux reconcile [resource]           — Trigger immediate reconciliation
  flux suspend [resource]             — Suspend reconciliation
  flux resume [resource]              — Resume reconciliation
  flux delete [resource]              — Delete a Flux resource
  flux export [resource]              — Export resource as YAML
  flux logs                           — View Flux controller logs
  flux events                         — View Flux events
  flux stats                          — View Flux resource statistics
  flux tree kustomization             — Show resource tree
  flux version                        — Show Flux version
  flux uninstall                      — Remove Flux from the cluster

  scenario                            — Start a guided lab
  clear                               — Clear the terminal
  help                                — Show this help

commands.flux export source git webapp:
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m0s
  ref:
    branch: main
  url: https://github.com/acme-corp/webapp
commands.flux export source git flux-system:
---
apiVersion: source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: GitRepository
metadata:
  name: flux-system
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 1m0s
  ref:
    branch: main
  secretRef:
    name: flux-system
  url: ssh://git@github.com/acme-corp/fleet-infra
commands.flux export kustomization webapp:
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m0s
  path: ./deploy/production
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: webapp
  targetNamespace: production
commands.flux export kustomization payments:
---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: payments
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 5m0s
  path: ./deploy/production
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: payments-api
  targetNamespace: production
